justification: Nothing to overthink here. Burrow just threw for 462 and five, he's QB1 in the whole league right now, and Mahomes stays glued to my bench where I put him three weeks ago - a fine quarterback for people who need a nightlight, and I already proved I don't. Hubbard ran for 119 total yards and a score on a league-average workload, that's two straight weeks of hot, he's locked into that flex for a third no matter what Carolina's defense looks like on paper. Jacobs is a real back doing real back things, Chase and Watson both went for buckets while Cincinnati and Green Bay threw it all over the field, and Loveland's the only tight end on this roster so he plays, full stop. Dobbins stays at RB2 - Henry's locked up from his early game anyway and I wouldn't have un-benched him even if he weren't, trust doesn't get a fourth chance just because somebody's bored of the bit. Tony's a respect guy, runs his backs angry, I get it - doesn't mean I'm not taking his best win away from him Sunday. 6-2, Golden Child, keep printing it, Kris.
